_comment_overrides: firebase-admin -> jwks-rsa depends on jose ^6, which is ESM-only. Vercel's Lambda module loader (/opt/rust/nodejs.js) overrides Node's Module._load and does NOT implement require()-of-ESM interop, so every admin API route crashed in production with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM -- even on Node 22.23 where stock Node supports it natively. jose 5.x ships a real CommonJS build; jwks-rsa only uses importJWK and exportSPKI, which are unchanged between v5 and v6.
